title: Quenchingly Juicy Uruguayan Squash Grill
description: A smoky grilled butternut squash seasoned with Chinese five spice powder, perfect for a comforting sick-day meal. The raclette grill brings out the squash's natural sweetness while keeping it juicy.

ingredients.name: butternut squash
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into 1cm thick slices

instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to medium-high heat.
Lightly coat each squash slice with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and Chinese five spice powder.
Place the slices on the grill and cook for 5 minutes on each side until caramelized and tender.
Drizzle soy sauce over the grilled squash during the last minute of cooking to add a savory glaze.
Remove the squash from the grill and let it rest for 2 minutes.
Serve the slices hot, optionally garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
